frontmatter.title: How Do LLM Agents Think Through SQL Join Orders?
frontmatter.author: Yuhao Zhang, Eric Liang, Ryan Marcus, Sid Taneja, ADRS Team
frontmatter.excerpt: This blog is part of a research collaboration with Databricks. We explore how LLM agents reason about SQL join orderings, analyzing their thinking traces to understand the strategies they employ — from anchor table selection and cluster decomposition to iterative hypothesis testing.
